summary: In addition to the Duo-specific 27.1 SDK, which allows third-party developers to get started adapting apps to the Duo’s new screen sizes and layouts, Apple’s developer site also has Figma and Sketch design kits. ★
title: Apple Releases Xcode 27.1, First SDK With Support for iPhone Duo
